gaps.wanted: the buried marks moved clear of the components that paint over them

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor

one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power`; one of `operating-temp`, `operating-temp-f2b`, `operating-temp-b2f` in a missing `attrs.environmental` section (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 8 bays (rear 8); `physical-context` on port group qsfp28 - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.attrs: datasheet (Hardware/Performance/Power/Supported-Transceivers sections; power figures are min idle / typical 32x SR4 at 30 percent load, 25 C ambient)
provenance.chassis: datasheet (Dimensions WxDxH 43.84 x 51.5 x 4.35 cm; Weight 10.87 kg)
provenance.cpu: datasheet says only 'Intel Xeon 4-Core'; model and clock (D-1518 @ 2.20GHz) from the live roc-spine1 entity dump (dumps/arcos-openconfig-components.json)
provenance.port-number-positions: drawing - CONFIRMED, not estimated. Measured off the datasheet front figure (working/datasheet/img-005.png sibling, img-007.png) at 2.18 px/mm: the odd number sits in the lamp band above the top row at 12.4mm and the even one below the bottom row at 39.3mm, against the 12.35 and 39.4 already modelled. The digit is printed in the bare metal BETWEEN the left and right lamp pairs. It was invisible because common/qsfp28-cage painted its whole box including that band; fixed in that skin at v3.2.0, not by moving a correct label
provenance.port-positions: photo-inferred; true 18.5mm pitch (measured ~18.8mm from photo), 6mm block gaps, human-reviewed round 5
provenance.rear-psu-marks: drawing - the right-hand strip carries, top to bottom, an airflow arrow, PS1, an earth symbol and the grounding screw, all on the lug centreline (datasheet rear figure, working/datasheet/img-005.png). They were one text mark holding a newline, which SVG renders as ONE line, so "< PS1" ran 16mm sideways into the mounting ear. Split into two marks, centred on the lug at 433.7 (and 4.7 for PS2), with the chevron replaced by a filled path triangle. It was tried as an arrow GLYPH first and came out as tofu: the renderer's font has no U+2190 and no U+25C0, so an arrow on this panel has to be drawn, the way the AGR420 pair legends draw theirs
provenance.top-bottom-sides: top from angled photo (grooves + front vent strip); bottom = two labels photo-inferred from a dark in-rack shot (big sticker edge visible ~155mm from front, second label front-left estimated) - reshoot on a bench for calibration; sides extrapolated from angled photo
